title: I Only Have Eyes for You, after Rod Stewart

details.title: I Only Have Eyes for You
details.lead: Rod Stewart's sung line, played straight on the trumpet. In his key, E♭, an octave up it would reach B♭5, so it is in C, a third lower: concert B3 to G5 (written C♯4 to A5).
facts: I Only Have Eyes for You, as Rod Stewart sings it on the recording you sent
Rod's voice, read note by note and straightened
C concert, D for the trumpet
The song as Rod sings it, with rests where the band plays alone
